topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes and outlines the expected learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic alterations in early cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic changes drive clonal fitness and phenotypic transformation during early tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies and specific cells of origin in initiating and propagating malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how chronic inflammatory cues and supportive stromal microenvironments promote malignant transformation and sustain established tumors.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the experimental models and high-resolution computational technologies used to map cancer evolutionary trajectories and spatial interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors interact to drive the evolutionary progression of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
